newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: New Zealand dollar seen rising further -Peters.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand dollar seen rising further -Peters.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar is likely to rise further over the long term, New Zealand Treasurer Winston Peters said on Sunday.
He told Reuters Financial Television "in the long term the (New Zealand) dollar will go on rising".
"It's the speed of the rise and ability of business people to adjust to it" that were of concern to the government, he said.
"I emphasise the level of the dollar is a sign of confidence in New Zealand's economy and current management," Peters said.
Peters was in Cebu for a meeting of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) finance ministers.
